Road were visited by members of the Special Branch in the
morning of November 12, 1937, when it was ascertained that
the Association had suspended activities of its own accord
and all its responsible members had vaca**〔此处转录不清〕** the premises.
A close watch on the said offic**〔此处转录不清〕** is being maintained

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
Section 1, Special Branch [手写模糊]
REPORT
Date November 10 1937.
(八一三救亡会)
Subject "The August 13" National Salvation Association - Removal of Offices.

Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien Forwarded by C. Gwilliam

The "August 13" National Salvation Association
which came into existence in the beginning of September, 1937,
with an office at that time on the premises of the Van Foh
Temple, Chengtu Road, has recently removed its office to No.
96 Kuling Road (Sinza District) and are operating as usual.
This Association was organized by persons mostly
of the educational and business class and has for its object
the participation in movements of a national salvation nature.
Some ninety members have registered with the Association.
The promoters of this organization include the
following individuals:-
Mr. Yue Tih Sien (俞迪光), a clerk in the employ
of the William, Hunt & Co., 133 Yuen Ming Yuen Rd;
Mr. Woo Chien Shu (胡堅樹), proprietor of the Woo
Ping Kee Lighter Company, Woochang Road:
Mr. Woo Wei Chung (〔此处转录不清〕), a clerk in the employ
of lawyer Zung Ching Yung (陳金容).

D.S.I.
D.C. (Special Branch).

（左侧批注：Warn not to others.）

报告
日期：1937年11月10日。
(八一三救亡会)
事由：“八一三”救亡会——办事处迁移。

呈报人：副督察长 Shih Ssu-chien 转呈人：C. Gwilliam

“八一三”救亡会成立于1937年9月初，当时办事处设在成都路万佛寺内，最近已将其办事处迁至古林路96号（新闸区），并照常运作。
该会主要由教育界和商界人士组织成立，其宗旨为参与救国性质的运动。
约有九十名会员在该会登记。
该组织的发起人包括以下人员：
俞迪光先生，圆明园路133号 William, Hunt & Co. 公司职员；
胡堅樹先生，武昌路吴平记驳船行业主；
Woo Wei Chung 先生（〔此处转录不清〕），律师 Zung Ching Yung (陳金容) 的职员。

副督察长
特务科副主任。

（左侧批注：Warn not to others.）
